# RovingFocusController

> Manages arrow-key roving tabindex focus across a set of child items.

## Constructor

```ts
new RovingFocusController(host: HTMLElement, options?: RovingFocusOptions)
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Required | Description |
|--------|------|----------|-------------|
| `selector` | `string` | no |  |
| `orientation` | `'horizontal' | 'vertical' | 'both'` | no |  |
| `wrap` | `boolean` | no |  |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | no |  |

## Methods

| Method | Parameters | Returns |
|--------|------------|---------|
| `attach()` | `—` | `void` |
| `detach()` | `—` | `void` |
| `destroy()` | `—` | `void` |

## Usage

```ts
import { RovingFocusController } from '@nonoun/native-ui';
const ctrl = new RovingFocusController(element, { /* options */ });
// In teardown: ctrl.destroy();
```
